text:
{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older units",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "disable the interface, wait a little and enable it again",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "> If the interface is UP but the counters stay at zero on the older units, > disable the interface, wait a little and enable it again. > Don't reboot the unit.",
    "said_by": "Erkki Expert",
    "said_by_role": "expert",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": false,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Thanks Erkki, did exactly that on TRN-087, traffic is back."
  },
  "reason": "An expert states a reusable rule to bounce the interface instead of rebooting when the link is up with zero counters after an SFP swap on older units, and the field engineer confirms it worked."
}
